decathlon-store-8330684-aquashoes-unisex.title: Aquashoes Unisex 100 Pool Beach Swimming Snorkeling Water Sports Protection Comfortable - Grey
decathlon-store-8330684-aquashoes-unisex.text:
Aquashoes Unisex 100 Pool Beach Swimming Snorkeling Water Sports Protection Comfortable - Grey
Beach enthusiasts, these aquatic shoes protect your feet. The studded soles of the Aquashoes 100 also prevents you from slipping into ideal aquatic adventure The studded soles of the Aquashoes 100 will also prevent you from slipping. It is an ideal aquatic shoe for all of your water adventures!
grip: 4 mm-thick studded sole. 
Designed to be used on sand
drying time: The design and components improve water drainage and drying
Which uses are these Aquashoes designed for? The Aquashoes 100 are designed for snorkelling and water hiking. Your feet are protected when you get in the water. Be careful not to damage marine life. 
They have been designed to provide the comfort you need on sandy beaches, which may also have small stones, and pebble beaches.
They are also suitable for other water sports: canoeing, kayaking, stand up paddling (SUP).
What size Aquashoes should I choose? Our Aquashoes have a slim and snug fit to keep your feet hydrodynamic when moving around in the water. We recommend choosing your usual shoe size. The best solution is to try them in the store, but keep in mind that if the size does not fit, you can exchange them!
Can I walk on rocks with them? The Aquashoes 100 have been designed to be used on loose terrain, such as sand. It is possible to walk on rocks with Decathlon’s Aquashoes 100, but you won’t enjoy optimal comfort. However, be careful on the slippery rocks or rocks covered in algae where the grip may be reduced.
Can I wash my shoes in the washing machine? It is possible to wash the Décathlon Aquashoes in a washing machine with detergent on a cycle of 30°C maximum, preferably with a delicate programme.
Let them then dry in the open air, avoiding the sun.
